Since the total number of voxels $V$ is the product of these dimensions, and the storage is 1 bit per voxel, the memory complexity is proportional to $V$ (specifically $V/32$ `uint32_t` elements, which is $O(V)$). The claim accurately reflects the storage mechanism described.
